thread:
marta_cs: Heads-up — Telesto Labs pilot needs APAC peering + temporary QPS bump starting ASAP. They want CIDR allowlist for 203.0.113.0/24 and single IP 198.51.100.45/32. Pilot window 72h. Can ops provision peering in APAC and apply 2x RL for the account? Also tagging renewal risk — they said convert to Dedicated if pilot meets latency/cost targets.

raj_ops: CC @devon_oncall. Quick check: which APAC region do they prefer? We have capacity in ap-southeast-1 (SG) right now; ap-south-1 is constrained. I can add CIDRs and bump RL once I have the account id + approved window. Need a support ticket for peering.

marta_cs: Account id is acct-0923-telesto. Start now, keep until 2026-03-25T23:59Z (72h). Renewal flagged as at-risk in ~2 weeks — we'll run enablement Wed. Contact is Lucy from Telesto (lucy_telesto).

devon_oncall: Sounds fine. Recommend SG region (ap-southeast-1) for lowest latency. If sales thinks they'll convert to Dedicated, we should note capacity reservation for next quarter.

lucy_telesto: Lucy (Telesto): Confirming IPs and dates, we approve 72h bump and SG region. I'll join the enablement call Wed 15:00 UTC. Thanks for the quick help.

raj_ops: Opening ticket INC-392345 for peering + allowlist. Planned steps: add CIDRs to tenant allowlist in ap-southeast-1, create peering request, apply temporary RL policy. Quick CLI I will run: 

```
redwood ctl allowlist add --account acct-0923-telesto --cidr 203.0.113.0/24 --cidr 198.51.100.45/32 --region ap-southeast-1
redwood ctl rate-limits update --account acct-0923-telesto --policy telesto-pilot --qps-multiplier 2 --expires 2026-03-25T23:59Z
```
I need a thumbs-up from @marta_cs to proceed.

infra-bot: system: Peering request queued (PR-5673). Estimated provisioning ~ 18 minutes.

marta_cs: :thumbsup: please proceed. I'll add renewal owner and attach enablement agenda + customer goals to the ticket.

raj_ops: Done — RL bump applied and CIDRs added in ap-southeast-1. INC-392345 updated with logs. PR-5673 shows peering established. Marking as provisioned; will monitor for 1h and escalate if errors.

sales_james: FYI — flagged for handoff to account exec after enablement. Looks promising for Dedicated conversion.

lucy_telesto: Seeing improved throughput, thank you. Will share post-enablement feedback.

raj_ops: Closing thread unless anyone sees issues — will reopen if we get alerts.
